title: Effect Size Gauge
summary: Cohen's d by hand with a pooled SD, then with effectsize::cohens_d(), with its confidence interval.
hints: Group sizes, means and SDs: `n1 <- length(lecture)`, `m1 <- mean(lecture)`, `s1 <- sd(lecture)`, and the same for `active`.
Pooled SD: `sqrt(((n1 - 1) * s1^2 + (n2 - 1) * s2^2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))`. Then `d_hand <- (m1 - m2) / sd_pooled`.
`d_pkg <- cohens_d(score ~ method, data = teach)`; the estimate is `d_pkg$Cohens_d` and the interval `c(d_pkg$CI_low, d_pkg$CI_high)`.
